title: How Low Can You Go: Fine-Tuning LLMs with Bayesian Optimization (LlMBO)
abstract: arXiv:2610.18504v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recently, Morris et al. introduced TinyLoRA, a strategy for LLM fine-tuning which introduces arbitrarily few parameters, and demonstrated accuracy improvements using less than $10$ parameters rather than the ${\gtrsim 10,000}$ typically demanded by LoRA-based methods. However, that study continued to use gradient-based local search methods of the kind deployed for training multi-billion parameter LLMs in the first place. This article is predicated on the observation that, in the low dimensional setting, global optimization methods become tractable, unlocking Large language Model Bayesian Optimization (LlMBO). LlMBO is sample-efficient, gradient-free, memory-light, parallelizes across devices without synchronization, and, unlike policy-gradient methods, can optimize greedy-decoding accuracy directly. translated_title: 你能低到什么程度：用贝叶斯优化微调大语言模型
translated_abstract: 最近，Morris等人提出了TinyLoRA，这是一种为大语言模型微调引入任意少量参数的策略，并证明了仅使用少于10个参数（而非基于LoRA的方法通常所需的约10,000个以上参数）即可实现准确率的提升。然而，该研究仍继续使用基于梯度的局部搜索方法——而这正是最初为训练数十亿参数大语言模型所部署的方法。本文基于这样一个观察：在低维设置下，全局优化方法变得可行，从而开启了大型语言模型贝叶斯优化。LlMBO具有样本高效、无需梯度、内存占用轻的特点，可以在设备间无需同步地进行并行，并且与策略梯度方法不同，它可以直接优化贪心解码准确率。我们描述了在数学基准测试套件上，将LlMBO与GRPO在多种模型的微调任务上进行比较的数值实验。
tldr: 本文提出LlMBO方法，利用低维微调场景下全局优化变得可行这一观察，将贝叶斯优化应用于大语言模型微调，实现了样本高效、无梯度、轻内存且可直接优化贪心解码准确率的微调方案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LlMBO, which leverages the observation that global optimization becomes tractable in low-dimensional settings to apply Bayesian optimization to LLM fine-tuning, achieving sample-efficient, gradient-free, memory-light fine-tuning that directly optimizes greedy-decoding accuracy.
